newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia joins MCC research consortium.
newsitem.headline: Nokia joins MCC research consortium.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Thursday it had become the first associate member of the research consortium Microelectronics and Computer Technology Corporation (MCC) based outside North America.

"The communications and information technology industries are global industries, and effective international cooperation can help open new markets and increase opportunities for all involved," Nokia quoted MCC CEO John McRary as saying in a statement.
MCC was a technology and research and development consortium owned by 17 corporations, Nokia said.
